digest.headline: A security fix to ship now, and two platform releases to read
digest.intro: The releases that matter this week.

items.title: OpenTofu 1.12.8
items.summary: Security fix: a crafted module source could read files outside the working directory.
items.whyItMatters: Every pipeline that runs plan on untrusted pull requests is exposed.
items.action: Upgrade OpenTofu in CI and on laptops.

items.title: Kubernetes 1.36
items.summary: Sidecar containers are stable and the last deprecated admission flags are removed.
items.whyItMatters: Clusters that still set the old flags fail to start after the upgrade.
items.action: run your own clusters or maintain Helm charts.

items.title: Ollama 0.14
items.summary: Model files can set a default seed, and the server reports memory use per model.
items.whyItMatters: Repeatable local runs get easier to set up.
items.action: serve models locally and pin versions.

items.title: Vitest 5.1
items.summary: Browser mode starts faster and the default reporter prints slow tests.

items.title: Node.js 24.9
items.summary: A routine release with fixes to the test runner and the HTTP client.
